## Research Complete: Comprehensive i18n/Localization Architecture Report ### 1. **@pantoken/i18n Package — The 45-Locale System** **Source of Truth for Locale List**: [packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts](packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts) **All 45 Canvas-supported Locales** (keyed by BCP47): ``` ar (Arabic, RTL) hy (Armenian) ca (Catalan) da (Danish) nl (Dutch) en (English — US) en-AU (English — Australia) en-CA (English — Canada) en-GB (English — United Kingdom) fi (Finnish) fr (French) fr-CA (French Canadian) ga (Irish Gaelic) de (German) el (Greek) ht (Haitian Creole) he (Hebrew, RTL) hi (Hindi) hu (Hungarian) — ONLY locale with full translations outside English is (Icelandic) id (Indonesian) it (Italian) ja (Japanese) ko (Korean) mi (Maori) ms (Malaysian) se (Northern Sami) nb (Norwegian Bokmål) nn (Norwegian Nynorsk) fa (Persian/Farsi, RTL) pl (Polish) pt (Portuguese) pt-BR (Portuguese Brazil) ru (Russian) zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese) sl (Slovenian) es (Spanish) sv (Swedish) th (Thai) zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese) tr (Turkish) uk (Ukrainian) vi (Vietnamese) cy (Welsh) ``` **Record Structure** (each locale): displays label, text direction (LTR/RTL), and display name - Example: `"hu": { label: "Hungarian (Magyar)", dir: "ltr" }` **What @pantoken/i18n Exports**: - [**CANVAS_LOCALES**](packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts#L20) — Record — static registry - [**registerLocalized(bundle | bcp47Tag)**](packages/i18n/src/index.ts#L71) — registers web-components with locale strings + direction - **Individual bundles** — exported as named `en`, `hu`, `ar`, etc. from [packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts](packages/i18n/src/locales/) - [**createLocaleSet()**](packages/i18n/src/index.ts#L137) — factory to constrain an app's supported locales at compile time (type-safe tree-shaking) - [**getDir(locale | bundle)**](packages/i18n/src/index.ts#L51) — infer text direction from CANVAS_LOCALES or a bundle - [**LocaleBundle type**](packages/i18n/src/locale-bundle.ts) — interface: locale, dir, label, strings (7 calendar/UI strings) **Format of Locale Data** (e.g., Hungarian): ```ts export const hu: LocaleBundle = defineBundle({ locale: "hu", dir: "ltr", label: "Hungarian (Magyar)", strings: makeStrings("hu", { prevMonth: "Előző hónap", nextMonth: "Következő hónap", dateLabel: "Dátum", datePlaceholder: "éééé-hh-nn", openCalendar: "Naptár megnyitása", timeLabel: "Idő", back: "Vissza", }), }); ``` **How Other Packages Consume @pantoken/i18n**: - Formats/tokens, formats/css, etc. do **not** currently consume i18n — they generate per-target output (e.g., CSS, SCSS), not per-locale - **@pantoken/web-components** bundles locales; applications call `registerLocalized(hu)` from `@pantoken/i18n` - **@pantoken/scaffold** and **@pantoken/create-pantoken-app** expose `--lang hu` CLI flag to detect user locale (7 UI strings in their own i18n caches for scaffolding prompts) --- ### 2. **Docs VitePress i18n Implementation** **Current Setup**: Only 2 locales (`root` English and `hu` Hungarian) **Type Definition**: [docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts#L4) ```ts export type DocsLocale = "root" | "hu"; ``` **Per-Locale Metadata** (defined in [LOCALES](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts#L82)): - `label`: Human label ("English" or "Magyar") - `lang`: IETF tag ("en-US", "hu-HU") - `guidePrefix`, `apiPrefix`: Route prefixes (/guide/, /hu/guide/, etc.) - `description`: Locale description (English version / Hungarian version) - `nav`: Navigation labels (guide, packages, css, api) - `sidebar`: Sidebar labels (intro, guides, components, plugins, etc.) - `editText`: Edit link text - `typedocSidebarPath`: Path to per-locale TypeDoc sidebar JSON - `themeSelector`: Theme selector UI strings (label, rebrand, canvas, canvas-high-contrast) - `cdnPicker`: CDN picker UI strings (all 30+ keys) - `getStartedTabs`: Tab labels - `chrome`: VitePress default theme UI strings (outline, docFooter, darkMode, langMenuLabel, notFound, etc.) - `search`: Local search UI strings (buttonText, noResultsText, footer actions, etc.) **VitePress Config Setup** ([docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts#L240)): Line 240-310: `localesConfig` is constructed from LOCALES entries via `Object.fromEntries(localeEntries.map(...))` - Each locale gets: `label`, `lang`, `title`, `description`, `themeConfig` with nav/sidebar/darkModeSwitchLabel/langMenuLabel/chrome/search - Line 518: Passed to VitePress as `locales: localesConfig` --- ### 3. **Language Picker/Switcher UI** **Location**: [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue) **Implementation**: - Line 19: `useLangs({ correspondingLink: true })` — VitePress built-in composable that reads the site config's locale setup - Returns `localeLinks` (array of links to other locales) and `currentLang` (metadata for current locale) - Line 67-71: Renders as a **menu flyout** with: - Title: `currentLang.label` (e.g., "English", "Magyar") - Links: Each locale link rendered as `` with `rel="alternate"` and `hreflang` attribute - Display condition: `showTranslations` computed from `localeLinks.value.length > 0` **Current UI State**: Rendered as a **language menu under a flyout** in the top nav, not a dropdown select. The menu appears in the extra navigation area (top right) alongside theme selector and appearance toggle. **HTML Structure**: ```vue

{{ currentLang.label }}

 ``` **VitePress Locale Linking**: The switcher is **not hardcoded** — it's driven by VitePress's built-in `locales` config at line 518, which reads the LOCALES dictionary. When you add a new locale to LOCALES, VitePress automatically adds it to localeLinks. --- ### 4. **Places That Hardcode "hu"/"root" (Should Support ~45 Locales)** **Hardcoded "hu" (Should Iterate Over All Locales)**: 1. **[docs/scripts/check-locale-drift.ts](docs/scripts/check-locale-drift.ts#L31)** (Line 31) ```ts const targets = Object.keys(LOCALES).filter((key) => key !== "root"); ``` ✓ **Correct pattern** — already filters out "root" and iterates all others 2. **[docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts)** (Lines 30, 69) - Line 30: `const huApiDir = join(docsRoot, "hu/api");` — hardcoded HU clone path - Line 69: `const localizeApiLink = (link: string): string => (/^\/api(\/|$)/.test(link) ? `/hu${link}` : link);` — hardcoded HU prefix for links - **Should be**: Parameterized per locale from a loop 3. **[docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts](docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts)** (Lines 12–24) ```ts const huGuideDir = join(docsRoot, "hu/guide"); const huApiDir = join(docsRoot, "hu/api"); const huIndex = join(docsRoot, "hu/index.md"); ``` - Checks only HU parity against root; should check all locales 4. **[docs/scripts/translate-guides.ts](docs/scripts/translate-guides.ts)** (Line 2 comment) - Comment mentions "each non-root locale" but implementation likely HU-only 5. **[packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts#L22)** (Line 22) ```ts targetLocales: ["hu"], ``` - **Should expand** to full 45-locale list or config-driven subset 6. **[ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts](ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts#L18)** (Line 18) ```ts targetLocales: ["hu"], ``` - Same — hardcoded to Hungarian only 7. **[packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts#L29-L31)** (Lines 29–31) ```ts const huPath = resolve(cacheDir, "hu.json"); const hu = JSON.parse(readFileSync(huPath, "utf8")); ``` - Checks only HU cache; should iterate all non-EN locales 8. **[ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/check-drift.ts](ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/check-drift.ts#L28-L31)** (Lines 28–31) - Same HU-only check pattern --- ### 5. **Where Translation Dictionaries/Glossaries Live** **i18n Cache Format** (translation memory): - **Location**: `docs/i18n-cache/` directory - **Files**: `root.api.json`, `root.guides.json`, `hu.api.json`, `hu.guides.json` (plus same for other locales if translated) - **Key Format**: SHA-256 hash — `sha256("docs\0" + key + "\0" + english text)` → translated text - **Content**: JSON object, keyed by hash, value is translated markdown/prose **Example** ([docs/i18n-cache/hu.guides.json](docs/i18n-cache/hu.guides.json) contains ~20 entries with Hungarian translations of guide prose) **Translation Adapters** ([tools/translation-adapters/src/index.ts](tools/translation-adapters/src/index.ts)): - **Interface**: `TranslationAdapter` with `translateBatch(items, onChunk?)` → Promise> - **Default**: `glossary` adapter — deterministic, reads static translation memory (i18n-cache/*.json) - **Alternative**: `ai` adapter (Claude-backed) — spawns AI command, sends prompt via stdin, parses JSON response - **Consumed by**: - [docs/scripts/api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts) — `GlossaryTranslationAdapter` and `AiTranslationAdapter` implementations - [docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts) — loads cache via `TranslationMemory.load(locale, "api")` **Build Scripts That Generate Locales**: 1. **docs:api** — [docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts) - Runs TypeDoc (generates EN API docs) - Clones to `docs/hu/api/` (HU-only currently) - Applies translation adapter to markdown 2. **docs:build** — invokes docs:api, then VitePress build - CI: `.github/workflows/docs.yml` runs `pnpm run generate && vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:build` 3. **i18n:translate** (packages/i18n) — `scripts/build-bundles.ts` - Regenerates [packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts](packages/i18n/src/locales/) from cache --- ### 6. **@cssdoc Glossary/AI Adapters** (referenced in instructions) **Location**: [docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts#L26-L29) comment references `glossary` and `ai` adapters **Actual Implementation**: Lives in the translation pipeline scripts, not a separate package. The adapters are: - **Glossary**: Static JSON cache lookups - **AI**: Spawn Claude/LLM via `DOCS_TRANSLATION_ADAPTER` env var (default: `claude-code`; alternative: `agy`) --- ### 7. **Build/CI Implications for Adding 45 Locales** **Current Bottlenecks**: 1. **TypeDoc → N×Locale Clones** - Currently: TypeDoc runs once → single EN output → cloned to `docs/hu/api/` - **For 45 locales**: Would need either: - (A) Run TypeDoc 45 times (3-5x build time increase), OR - (B) Post-process single output 45 times (marginal time, moderate disk) - **Memory**: Each clone is ~2–5 MB (50+ markdown files); 45 locales = ~100–225 MB extra disk 2. **Translation Adapter Performance** - **Glossary adapter**: Hash lookup, negligible time (current) — works for all 45 if caches populated - **AI adapter**: Spawns Claude per-batch (currently 1 batch per locale) — 45 locales = 45+ API calls, higher cost/time - **Mitigation**: Batch translate all locales in one run, or parallelize adapter calls 3. **Build Time**: - **Docs dev** (`vp run docs:dev`): Currently ~2–3s (EN only, fast HMR) - **Docs build** (`vp run docs:build`): Currently ~10–15s (EN + HU) - **Full 45-locale build**: Estimated 30–60s (TypeDoc + 45 adapters), or 2–5× if running TypeDoc per locale 4. **CI Workflow**: - [.github/workflows/docs.yml](.github/workflows/docs.yml) runs `pnpm run generate && vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:build` - Currently: ~5–10 min total for docs - **For 45 locales**: ~15–30 min (if TypeDoc runs 45×) or ~10–15 min (if post-process) --- ### Summary Table | Component | Files | Current Support | Hardcoded Refs | Notes | |-----------|-------|-----------------|-----------------|-------| | **@pantoken/i18n** | packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts | 45 locales | None (correct) | Source of truth; CANVAS_LOCALES registry | | **Web-components** | renderers/web-components/ | 45 bundles | None | Uses CANVAS_LOCALES; per-app choice | | **Docs VitePress** | docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts | 2 locales (root, hu) | Type: DocsLocale = "root" \| "hu" | Only 2 locale metadata defined | | **Docs Config** | docs/.vitepress/config.ts | 2 locales | localesConfig (line 240) | Loops LOCALES, but LOCALES only has 2 | | **Language Picker** | docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue | VitePress-driven | None (config-driven) | useLangs() reads locales from config | | **API Docs Build** | docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts | 2 locales | huApiDir, hu prefix links | Clones to `hu/api/`, localizeApiLink hardcoded | | **Locale Parity Check** | docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts | 2 locales | huGuideDir, huApiDir, huIndex | Checks HU vs root only | | **Docs Drift Check** | docs/scripts/check-locale-drift.ts | All non-root | ✓ Uses filter() | Already correct | | **Scaffold/AI Translate** | packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts, ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts | 1 locale | targetLocales: ["hu"] | Hardcoded; should expand | --- **To expand docs to support all 45 Canvas locales**, you would need to: 1. Expand `DocsLocale` type and `LOCALES` dict in [docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts) from 2 to 45 entries 2. Refactor [docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts) to loop over all locales instead of hardcoding `huApiDir` 3. Update [docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts](docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts) to verify parity for all locales 4. Populate `docs/i18n-cache/{locale}.json` for each new locale (currently only `hu` is full; others are empty) 5. Expand [packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts) and [ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts](ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts) to include full locale list in `targetLocales`

{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/session/plan.md", "file_text": "# Plan: Expand i18n to all 45 Canvas locales + searchable language picker

## Decisions (from user)
- Infra for all 45 locales now; translated *content* fills in incrementally via existing
  `docs:locales:translate` / `docs:locales:translate:agy` pipeline (glossary passthrough is the
  safe default until AI-translated).
- Also expand `packages/scaffold` and `ai/pantoken-ai` translate/check-drift scripts from
  hardcoded `hu` to all 45.
- Language picker: replace VitePress's flyout menu list with a custom searchable combobox (not a
  plain `<select>` — 45 options need filtering/typeahead).
- Per-locale API docs: single TypeDoc run (English), post-processed/translated per locale (current
  hu approach), not re-run TypeDoc 45×.
- Exact locale set: all 45, matching `@pantoken/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES` (44 entries) + docs' "root"
  == the `en` entry (so 45 route locales total: root + 44 non-en keys).

## Key findings
- `packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts` `CANVAS_LOCALES` is the correct, already-complete
  45-locale source of truth (label + dir per BCP47 tag). Docs should consume this instead of
  duplicating a locale list.
- `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts` `DocsLocale`/`LOCALES` currently hand-writes full UI-string blocks
  (nav, sidebar, chrome, cdnPicker, getStartedTabs, themeSelector, search — ~80 strings) per
  locale, in TS literals. This does not scale to 45 — must NOT hand-author 44 more blocks.
- `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` is already fully data-driven off `LOCALES` (loops `Object.entries`) —
  **no changes needed there** beyond it receiving a bigger `LOCALES` map.
- `docs/scripts/translate-guides.ts` and `docs/scripts/check-locale-drift.ts` already loop
  `Object.keys(LOCALES).filter(k => k !== "root")` — **already correct**, no hardcoding.
- `docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts` hardcodes a single `huApiDir`/`localizeApiLink` — needs
  generalizing to loop all locales.
- `docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts` hardcodes hu paths only — needs generalizing.
- **Critical bug to fix**: `docs/scripts/api-translation.ts`'s `GlossaryTranslationAdapter`
  (`SORTED_REPLACEMENTS`) is a single hardcoded **Hungarian** structural-term dictionary applied
  unconditionally (headings like "Parameters"→"Paraméterek", badges, table labels). It's invisible
  today because hu is the only non-root locale. Once more locales are added, every non-hu build
  using the default `glossary` adapter would stamp Hungarian words into French/German/etc docs.
  Must become locale-parameterized: keep the existing hu term map, and default to identity
  (passthrough) for any locale without a defined term map, so builds stay correct until translated.
- VitePress routes require **physical per-locale folders** (`docs/<locale>/guide/*.md`,
  `docs/<locale>/api/`, `docs/<locale>/index.md`) — no `rewrites:` config is used; this is how `hu`
  already works and the same pattern extends to all 44 non-root locales.
- English regional variants (`en-AU`, `en-CA`, `en-GB`) still get real per-locale trees (per user's
  "all 45 exactly" choice), but since the glossary adapter passthrough is English-identity by
  default, no translation cost — they build as English copies automatically once their locale
  folders exist and the pipeline runs.
- Language picker lives in `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue`, driven by
  VitePress's built-in `useLangs()` composable — reads `localeLinks`/`currentLang` off whatever
  `locales` config exists; already correctly data-driven, only the *rendering* (flyout list) needs
  to change to a combobox.
- `docs/i18n-cache/` currently only has `hu.api.json` / `hu.guides.json` (content-addressed
  translation memory, `TranslationMemory.load(locale, namespace)`). New namespace `chrome` (or
  `ui`) needed for the UI-string dictionary described below.
- `packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts` (`targetLocales: ["hu"]`) and
  `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts` (same) plus their `check-drift.ts` siblings (hu-only cache
  check) are the other two "hardcoded hu" surfaces confirmed by research.
- No existing combobox/autocomplete component in `@pantoken/components` to reuse — the picker will
  be a bespoke Vue component in `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/`.

**Steps**

### Phase 1 — Canonical locale source + docs locale typing
1. Add `@pantoken/i18n` as a `docs` devDependency (build-time only; VitePress config/scripts run in
   Node). *No dependency on other phases.*
2. In `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, replace the hand-written `DocsLocale` union with a type derived
   from `CANVAS_LOCALES` keys (root + all keys except `"en"`, since `"en"` maps to `"root"`).
3. Split `LocaleMeta` into (a) **structural fields** computed directly from `CANVAS_LOCALES` +
   locale key: `label`, `lang` (the BCP47 tag itself, `en-US` for root), `dir`, `guidePrefix`,
   `apiPrefix`, `typedocSidebarPath` — and (b) **translatable UI-string fields** (nav, sidebar,
   chrome, cdnPicker, getStartedTabs, themeSelector, search, editText, description) sourced from a
   new merge step (Phase 2).

### Phase 2 — Translatable UI-string pipeline (*depends on Phase 1*)
1. Extract the current English UI-string block (today's `LOCALES.root` minus structural fields)
   into a single flat English source object (e.g. `docs/.vitepress/theme/chrome-strings.ts`),
   keyed the same shape as today's `LocaleMeta` UI fields.
2. Add a new translation-memory namespace, e.g. `docs/i18n-cache/<locale>.chrome.json`, and a new
   script `docs/scripts/translate-chrome.ts` (mirrors `translate-guides.ts`: flattens the strings
   object to `{id, text}` units, runs through `createTranslationAdapter()`/`TranslationMemory`,
   writes back a nested JSON per locale). Wire it into `package.json`'s
   `docs:guides:locales`/`:claude`/`:agy` scripts (or a parallel `docs:chrome:locales:*` set) and
   into `docs:locales:translate`/`:agy` aggregate scripts.
3. In `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, build each non-root locale's UI-string fields by deep-merging the
   locale's `<locale>.chrome.json` cache (if present) over the English defaults — so any
   untranslated locale silently falls back to English chrome text instead of crashing or showing
   `undefined`.
4. Existing hard-coded `hu` UI strings become the seed/initial content for `hu.chrome.json` (one-
   time migration, not hand-authored per new locale).

### Phase 3 — Fix the glossary structural-term adapter (*parallel with Phase 2*)
1. In `docs/scripts/api-translation.ts`, change `GlossaryTranslationAdapter` to accept a `locale` in
   its constructor and look up a `Record<locale, Array<[RegExp, string]>>` term map; keep the
   existing array as the `hu` entry; every other locale defaults to `[]` (pure passthrough).
2. Update all call sites that construct `new GlossaryTranslationAdapter()` (or
   `createTranslationAdapter()`) to pass the target locale through
   (`build-api-locales.ts`, `translate-guides.ts`, new `translate-chrome.ts`).
3. Add a regression test (or extend an existing one) asserting a non-hu locale's glossary pass is
   identity (no Hungarian substitutions leak into e.g. a `de` build).

### Phase 4 — Generalize per-locale build/check scripts (*depends on Phase 1*)
1. `docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts`: replace the single `huApiDir`/`localizeApiLink` with a loop
   over `Object.keys(LOCALES).filter(k => k !== "root")`, parameterizing the clone target dir and
   the link-prefix regex per locale (`/^\/api(\/|$)/` → `/hu${...}` becomes
   `` `/${locale}${...}` ``).
2. `docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts`: replace the hu-only path triple with a loop over all
   configured locales, checking guide/api/index parity for each against root.
3. Re-verify `check-locale-drift.ts` and `translate-guides.ts` need no changes (already loop
   `LOCALES`), only confirm they still pass with 45 locales configured.
4. Scaffold the 44 new locale folders (`docs/<locale>/guide/`, `docs/<locale>/api/`,
   `docs/<locale>/index.md`) via the generalized scripts running once locally (or a small one-off
   bootstrap script) rather than hand-created.

### Phase 5 — Language picker: searchable combobox (*depends on Phase 1, parallel with Phases 2-4*)
1. Build `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/LanguagePicker.vue`: ARIA combobox pattern
   (`role="combobox"` input + `role="listbox"` popup), filters `useLangs().localeLinks` by typed
   text (matches label or lang tag), keyboard nav (Up/Down/Enter/Escape), navigates via
   `window.location.href = link` on selection (matches existing `VPMenuLink` full-navigation
   behavior — VitePress locale switch is a real page load, not an SPA route change).
2. Swap it into `VPNavBarExtra.vue` in place of the `<div class="group translations">` block
   (`VPMenuLink` loop), keeping `showTranslations`/`currentLang` gating logic as-is.
3. Style to match existing flyout aesthetics (reuse pantoken tokens already used elsewhere in
   `docs/.vitepress/theme/**`); ensure it works in the mobile nav variant too if `VPNavBarExtra` is
   reused there.
4. Manually verify in a real browser (per repo convention — no automated visual test for VitePress
   theme chrome).

### Phase 6 — Expand scaffold + pantoken-ai translate scripts (*parallel with Phases 2-5*)
1. `packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts` and `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts`: change
   `targetLocales: ["hu"]` to the full 45-locale list, sourced from
   `@pantoken/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES` (import, map keys, translate `en`→`root`-equivalent as N/A
   since it's the source).
2. `packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts` and `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/check-drift.ts`: replace
   the single hardcoded `hu.json` check with a loop over all target locales (still "warn if
   missing, fail if incomplete" semantics already in place for hu).
3. Confirm `renderers/web-components`'s equivalent `translate:agy` script (uses the same
   `runI18nTranslationCli` helper) doesn't also need a `targetLocales` bump — check whether it
   already targets all 45 (per repo memory, web-components/i18n bundles already ship 44 locales) or
   also needs the same fix.

### Phase 7 — Security docs + changeset
1. Review `ASSURANCE.md`/`SECURITY.md` — this change adds no new external input surface (locale
   picker navigates to already-generated static routes; translation scripts run offline/at build
   time), so likely no edits needed, but explicitly confirm during implementation per repo
   instructions.
2. Run `pnpm changeset` for the user-visible change (all `@pantoken/docs`, `@pantoken/scaffold`,
   `@pantoken/pantoken-ai` consumers now see 45 locales).

**Relevant files**
- `packages/i18n/src/lib/canvas-locales.ts` — reuse `CANVAS_LOCALES` as source of truth (read-only).
- `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts` — core refactor: `DocsLocale` type, `LOCALES` construction, structural vs
  translated split.
- `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` — no logic changes expected; verify it still works with 45 entries.
- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue` — swap translations block for new combobox.
- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/LanguagePicker.vue` — new file, searchable combobox.
- `docs/scripts/api-translation.ts` — `GlossaryTranslationAdapter` locale-parameterization.
- `docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts` — generalize hu-only clone/link logic to loop all locales.
- `docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts` — generalize hu-only parity check to loop all locales.
- `docs/scripts/translate-chrome.ts` — new script, mirrors `translate-guides.ts` for UI strings.
- `docs/i18n-cache/*.chrome.json` — new per-locale translation memory namespace.
- `docs/package.json` — add `@pantoken/i18n` dep; add `docs:chrome:locales*` scripts, wire into
  `docs:locales:translate`/`:agy`.
- `packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts`, `packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts` — expand to 45.
- `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts`, `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/check-drift.ts` — expand to 45.
- `renderers/web-components/package.json` scripts — verify/confirm already covers 45 (no change
  expected, per repo memory).

**Verification**
1. `vp run docs:check:drift` and `vp run docs:check:locales` pass with all 45 locales configured
   (glossary-only content is fine — drift check only requires cache keys to exist, not AI quality).
2. `vp run docs:build` completes and produces `docs/.vitepress/dist/<locale>/...` for all 45 route
   locales; spot-check a non-hu, non-en locale (e.g. `de`) renders English-passthrough chrome text
   (no leaked Hungarian) and correct `hreflang`/`lang` attributes.
3. `vp run docs:dev` — manually open the new language picker, confirm typeahead filters the 45-item
   list, keyboard nav (arrows/enter/escape) works, and selecting a locale navigates to the
   corresponding localized route.
4. `vp test` for `packages/scaffold` and `ai/pantoken-ai` — `check-drift.ts` reports the expanded
   locale set without failing (missing translations should warn, not fail, matching current hu
   semantics).
5. `vp check` (format/lint/type-check) across touched packages.
6. Run `pnpm changeset` and confirm a `.changeset/*.md` file is committed.

**Further Considerations**
1. Populating real (non-passthrough) translations for 41 new locales is a large ongoing cost — this
   plan only wires infra + safe English-passthrough fallback; actual `docs:locales:translate:agy`
   AI-translation runs per locale are a separate, incremental follow-up (as the user requested).
2. `renderers/web-components`'s `translate:agy` script wasn't fully inspected — Phase 6 step 3 is a
   verification task, may turn out to need no change.

## Plan: Expand i18n to all 45 Canvas locales + searchable language picker

**TL;DR**: `packages/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES` (44 BCP47 locales) is already the correct source of truth. Docs currently hand-writes UI strings for only `root`/`hu` in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts`, which won't scale to 45. The fix: split docs locale metadata into *structural* fields (derived from `CANVAS_LOCALES`) and *translatable UI strings* (moved into a new translation-memory cache namespace so they fill in incrementally via the existing AI/glossary pipeline, falling back to English until translated). Along the way, fix a hidden bug where the "glossary" adapter's structural-term dictionary is hardcoded Hungarian-only (harmless today since hu is the only non-root locale, but would corrupt every other language's docs once more locales exist). Generalize the two scripts that hardcode `hu` paths, replace the language-picker flyout with a searchable combobox, and expand `packages/scaffold`/`ai/pantoken-ai` translate scripts from `hu`-only to all 45.

**Steps**

1. **Canonical locale typing** — `docs` depends on `@pantoken/i18n`; `DocsLocale` derives from `CANVAS_LOCALES` keys (root + 44 non-`en`); `LocaleMeta` splits into structural fields (label/lang/dir/prefixes, computed) vs. translatable UI strings (merged from cache).
2. **UI-string translation pipeline** (*depends on 1*) — extract English chrome/nav/sidebar/etc. strings to one flat source object; new `docs/scripts/translate-chrome.ts` + `docs/i18n-cache/<locale>.chrome.json` namespace, mirroring `translate-guides.ts`; `i18n.ts` merges cache over English defaults per locale.
3. **Fix hardcoded-Hungarian glossary adapter** (*parallel with 2*) — `GlossaryTranslationAdapter` becomes locale-parameterized; only `hu` keeps its term map, everything else passes through identity.
4. **Generalize build/check scripts** (*depends on 1*) — `build-api-locales.ts` and `check-locale-parity.ts` loop all configured locales instead of hardcoding `hu`; `translate-guides.ts`/`check-locale-drift.ts` already loop correctly, just verify.
5. **Language picker** (*depends on 1, parallel with 2-4*) — new `LanguagePicker.vue` (ARIA combobox: filterable input + listbox, keyboard nav) replacing the `VPMenuLink` flyout list in `VPNavBarExtra.vue`.
6. **Expand scaffold + pantoken-ai** (*parallel with 2-5*) — `translate.ts`/`check-drift.ts` in both packages move from `targetLocales: ["hu"]` to the full 45; verify `renderers/web-components`'s equivalent script already covers 45.
7. **Docs/changeset** — confirm no `ASSURANCE.md`/`SECURITY.md` changes needed (no new input surface); run `pnpm changeset`.

**Relevant files**
- [docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts) — core type/data refactor
- [docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts) — already data-driven, verify only
- [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue) — swap in new picker
- [docs/scripts/api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts) — locale-parameterize glossary
- [docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts), [docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts](docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts) — generalize
- [docs/package.json](docs/package.json) — new dep + scripts
- [packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/translate.ts), [packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/check-drift.ts)
- `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/translate.ts`, `ai/pantoken-ai/scripts/check-drift.ts`

**Verification**
1. `docs:check:drift`, `docs:check:locales`, `docs:build` pass with 45 locales; spot-check a new non-hu locale renders English passthrough, no leaked Hungarian.
2. Manual browser check of the new combobox (filtering, keyboard nav, navigation).
3. `vp test` for scaffold/pantoken-ai drift checks; `vp check`; changeset committed.

**Further considerations**
1. Actual AI translation of 41 new locales is a separate incremental follow-up, not part of this infra change.
2. Whether `renderers/web-components` translate script needs the same expansion is unconfirmed — verify during implementation.

Full detail saved to [plan.md](/memories/session/plan.md). Let me know if you want changes before handoff to implementation.
